name: Bunny Hero Works Part-Time
source:
You died becaused you gooned too hard. Before ascending to heaven (or hell), a mysterious voice pulled you over. After seeing your potential, it decided to give you an enticing proposal.

You, the protagonist, will reincarnate in another world as the bunny hero, tasked with the mission to fuck as many girls as possible and conquer the world via SEX. Can you do that?

I guess we are about to find out.

[From [url=https://bunify.itch.io/bunny-hero-works-part-time]Itchio[/url]]
translation:
你因为手冲过度而精尽人亡。在升入天堂（或者坠入地狱）之前，一个神秘的声音把你拉了过去。看中你的潜质后，它向你提出了一个诱人的交易。

身为男主角的你将作为“兔耳勇者”转生到异世界，肩负起尽可能多睡妹子、用性爱征服世界的使命。你能做得到吗？

我想我们很快就能见分晓了。

[摘自[url=https://bunify.itch.io/bunny-hero-works-part-time]Itch.io[/url]]
